objective: Verify the Vitals module can be opened and the requirement-specified primary action completes in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
verifies: verifies nominal completion of the primary action in the Vitals module and the resulting system state update with audit log creation
protocol: Log in as a test user with the appropriate role in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
Ensure the Vitals module is active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and state change.
